リップスティックプラント

light.best.quote: The lipstick plant needs bright indirect light (but not full sun).

light.min.reason: 出典に暗い場所（Deep shade）への耐性の記載がないため、明るい日陰の一段下までとした

light.directSun.quote: The lipstick plant needs bright indirect light (but not full sun).

temperature.minC.quote: If the temperature falls below 50 degrees, leaf drop will occur.

temperature.idealC.quote: does best when the soil temperatures will stay between 65 and 70 degrees Fahrenheit during the growing season

humidity.quote: The lipstick plant enjoys high humidity but with air circulation

watering.growing.quote: Water them often but be sure the potting soil has good drainage.

watering.winter.quote: During the winter, it can be kept a bit cooler and drier.

tips.quote: If the temperature falls below 50 degrees, leaf drop will occur.

tips.ja: 葉をぬらさず、土に触れさせないとカビの病気を防げる。
tips.quote: Fungal problems can be avoided by keeping leaves dry and out of contact with potting medium.

tips.ja: 生育期に薄い液体肥料（ラン用など）を与えると、葉が茂り花が咲きやすい。
tips.quote: Using a dilute liquid fertilizer, such as one made for orchids, during the growing season will encourage leaf growth and blooming.
